# Luis Fernando Barrera — CV

> Software Engineering Manager | AI-Augmented Development | Payments, Finance & Accounting Platforms

## About this repository

This is a Curriculum Vitae production system. The canonical content lives in `luisfernandobarrera.resume.json` (JSON Resume format). The site is generated with Flask + Jinja2 + Frozen Flask as static HTML and deployed to GitHub Pages.

## Quick links

- **Live CV**: https://cv.luisfernandobarrera.com
- **JSON data**: `luisfernandobarrera.resume.json`
- **Templates**: `templates/cv.html`, `templates/cv-columns.html`
- **Styles**: `templates/sass/style.sass`
- **PDF**: `docs/resume.pdf` (generated externally)
- **AGENTS.md** includes human+AI collaboration rules

## Key structure

- `luisfernandobarrera.resume.json` — all CV data (basics, work, projects, skills, education, languages)
- `app.py` — Flask application serving the CV
- `gen_static.py` — Frozen Flask static site generator
- `templates/` — Jinja2 HTML templates (cv.html, cv-columns.html, print-cv.html, base.html)
- `docs/` — generated static site output (GitHub Pages root)
- `pyproject.toml` — Python dependencies (Flask, Frozen-Flask, libsass, WeasyPrint)

## Tech stack

- Python (Flask, Frozen-Flask)
- Jinja2 templating
- SASS (libsass)
- JSON Resume format
- WeasyPrint for PDF generation

## Editing conventions

See `AGENTS.md` for full collaboration rules. Key points:
- `luisfernandobarrera.resume.json` is the source of truth
- Use past tense for completed roles, present for current
- Lead highlights with outcomes/impact
- Small, focused edits preferred
